notes: New: Wingman can run its own FTP, SFTP, and TFTP server so a device uploads files straight to your computer (e.g. "copy running-config tftp://<wingman-ip>/"). Received files land in your Downloads folder.
Start each server from Settings → File servers, or just ask Wingman. They're off by default, open a firewall hole only while running, and auto-stop after 24 hours.
